payload.notes: E1-T01/T02/T03 designs are unchanged — do not re-read them for new instructions. Only E1-T04 is new: see the 'E1-T04 — Unit Test Coverage for Backend Foundation' section in design.md, plus ADR-7 (testing policy) and ADR-8 (node:test + tsx, zero new dependencies). E1-T04 requires E1-T03 to be merged first, since two of its test files import T03's middleware. E1-T04 is tests-only: the sole permitted src/ change is extracting the pure `loadEnv(source)` seam in src/config/env.ts exactly as specified; if any other src/ change seems necessary, STOP and write to questions.md.
